# Vendored Plugin Versions

Breadcrumb for re-vendoring these community plugins. To update: download the
three release assets (`main.js`, `manifest.json`, `styles.css`) into the
plugin's folder using the URL pattern below, then update the version line.

## Templater

- **Version:** 2.24.3
- **Downloaded:** 2026-07-25
- **Upstream repo:** https://github.com/SilentVoid13/Templater
- **Release asset URLs:** `https://github.com/SilentVoid13/Templater/releases/latest/download/{main.js,manifest.json,styles.css}` — download all three into `.obsidian/plugins/templater-obsidian/`

## Meta Bind

- **Version:** 1.5.1
- **Downloaded:** 2026-07-25
- **Upstream repo:** https://github.com/mProjectsCode/obsidian-meta-bind-plugin
- **Release asset URLs:** `https://github.com/mProjectsCode/obsidian-meta-bind-plugin/releases/latest/download/{main.js,manifest.json,styles.css}` — download all three into `.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-meta-bind-plugin/`
